$comment: Exact tested pi/pi-tui compatibility units (one unit = a pi install plus its nested pi-tui). implementationHashes are djb2 hex hashes of Markdown.prototype.render.toString() and getMarkdownTheme.toString() for the locked version; populate/refresh per version with: PI_PACKAGE_ROOT=<fixture-root> node scripts/check-upstream.mjs --update-allowlist. Hash checks are diagnostic compatibility gates, not security authentication.

markdownThemeSignature.$comment: Shared by the locked 0.80.7 and 0.82.1 fixtures. versions permits a future per-version override. codeBlockIndent is the optional string added by interactive mode's spread wrapper. Source signatures are compatibility gates, not authentication; matching callbacks must be deterministic, side-effect-free, and input-transparent.

cacheBudgetCalibration.$comment: budgetChars remains the legacy source-char-era input for extension compatibility. Cache modules translate it to conservative retained-cost units; Tasks 6/7 may replace this bridge with directly calibrated values. Approximate KiB figures describe estimate units, not measured heap bytes.
